data.description: RED task. Create plugins/dso/scripts/rollback-bridge-cutover.sh as an idempotent bash rollback playbook modeled on rollback-sub-pr-cutover.sh. Named-step exit codes for each phase. Env overrides: DSO_ROLLBACK_REPO_ROOT, DSO_ROLLBACK_VERIFY_TIMEOUT (default 2400s), DSO_ROLLBACK_CUTOVER_SHA. Steps: (1) git revert --no-commit DSO_ROLLBACK_CUTOVER_SHA, (2) restore cursor snapshot from bridge_state/bootstrap/, (3) gh run watch for CI verification. chmod +x required.
data.title: Add rollback-bridge-cutover.sh with revert + cursor-restore + gh-run verification
